title: Study Abroad Plans
promptText:
Please introduce yourself. For example, you could talk about one or more of the following:

• Your interests
• Your plans for future study
• Why you want to study abroad
• Why you need to learn English
• Why you chose this test
referenceAnswerText: Hello, my name is Minh and I am twenty-two years old. I have just finished my bachelor's degree in computer science in Ho Chi Minh City. I am very interested in artificial intelligence, so I plan to do a master's degree in Australia next year. I need a good English score because all of the courses are taught in English. I chose this test because it is fast, fair and accepted by my university.

source.name: #1 Study Abroad Plans
source.note: Self-written prompt; referenceAnswerText is a sample answer (task is unscored).

title: Hometown and Background
promptText:
Please introduce yourself. For example, you could talk about one or more of the following:

• Where you grew up
• Your education background
• What you are doing now
• Your goals for the next five years
referenceAnswerText: Hi, my name is Lan. I grew up in Da Nang, a coastal city in central Vietnam that is famous for its beaches. I studied business administration at a local university and now I work as a marketing assistant for a tourism company. In the next five years, I hope to become a marketing manager and to work with international clients, which is why improving my English is so important to me.

source.name: #2 Hometown and Background
source.note: Self-written prompt; referenceAnswerText is a sample answer (task is unscored).

title: Hobbies and Free Time
promptText:
Please introduce yourself. For example, you could talk about one or more of the following:

• Your hobbies
• How you spend your weekends
• A skill you would like to learn
• A place you would like to visit
referenceAnswerText: Hello, I am Huy. In my free time, I love playing football and taking photos of street life. At the weekend, I usually go to the countryside with my friends or visit a coffee shop to read. One skill I would really like to learn is cooking, because I want to live independently when I study overseas. Someday, I would love to visit New Zealand to see its mountains and lakes.

source.name: #3 Hobbies and Free Time
source.note: Self-written prompt; referenceAnswerText is a sample answer (task is unscored).

title: Career and English
promptText:
Please introduce yourself. For example, you could talk about one or more of the following:

• Your current or desired job
• Your work experience
• Why you need a PTE score
• How you will use English at work
referenceAnswerText: Good morning, my name is Thao and I am a registered nurse. I have worked at a hospital in Hanoi for three years, mainly in the emergency department. I need a PTE score to apply for nursing registration in Australia, where I hope to continue my career. At work, I will use English every day to talk with patients, explain treatments clearly and communicate with doctors and other nurses.

source.name: #4 Career and English
source.note: Self-written prompt; referenceAnswerText is a sample answer (task is unscored).
